newsitem.title: USA: Tribune names new CEO for Chicago Tribune.
newsitem.headline: Tribune names new CEO for Chicago Tribune.

text.p: The Tribune Co said Monday it named Scott Smith president and chief executive of its flagship newspaper, the Chicago Tribune.

Scott will replace Jack Fuller, who was named executive vice president of Tribune Publishing Company and will be repsonsible for the group's four daily newspapers and their related developing businesses, as well as the company's Tribune Media Services.
Fuller replaces Joseph Cantrell, who retires March 31.

Smith is currently president, chief executive officer and publisher of the South Florida-based Sun-Sentinel Co and had been senior vice president/development and chief financial officer for Tribune Company.
Fuller was named president and chief executive officer of the Chicago Tribune in September 1993 and was named publisher of the newspaper in June 1994.
The appointments are effective May 1, the company said.
